title: Website builder
subtitle: Build your landing page from sections. Changes are saved as a draft.
draftNote: Edits only change your draft. The live website is not affected until you publish.

template.title: Template

descriptions.classic: Full story: about, gallery, team, testimonials, FAQ and contact.
descriptions.minimal: Short and focused: hero, workshops, FAQ and location.

template.hint: Switching template keeps the content of sections that exist in both.
template.confirmText: Sections of the same type keep their content. Sections that are not part of the new template are removed from the draft, and the theme is reset to the template default.

sections.title: Sections
sections.footerLocked: The footer is required and always stays last.
sections.dndInstructions: Press space to pick up a section, use the arrow keys to move it, then press space to drop it. Press escape to cancel.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hexInvalid: Use a 6-digit hex colour such as #9a3412.
theme.contrastLow: Contrast with white text is {ratio}:1. Buttons need at least {min}:1 to be readable. Choose a darker colour.
theme.fontHint: All listed fonts fall back to system fonts that support Vietnamese, Korean and Japanese.
theme.uploadPlaceholder: Image upload is coming soon. For now, paste a secure (https) image link.

publish.title: Publish
publish.suspended: This website is suspended. Contact support to restore it.
publish.pending: Your website was submitted and is waiting for review. You can keep editing the draft.
publish.publishHint: Publishing makes the current draft live immediately.
publish.fixErrors: Fix {count, plural, one {# section} other {# sections}} marked as needing attention first.
publish.publishedMock: Draft published (demo only, nothing was sent to a server).

prereq.workshop: At least one active workshop with an upcoming session

publish.submitDisabled: Complete the checklist to submit your website for review.

editor.title: Edit: {name}
editor.missingTranslation: No translation for this language yet. Visitors will see the default language instead: {fallback}

errors.httpsUrl: Use a secure link starting with https://
errors.mapsUrl: Only Google Maps links are allowed (google.com/maps or maps.app.goo.gl).

hints.imageUrl: A secure image link starting with https://
hints.linkUrl: A secure link starting with https://

editor.autoWorkshops: Workshops are loaded automatically from your active workshops. Manage them on the Workshops page.
editor.authenticityNote: You are responsible for the authenticity of testimonials. Only publish real reviews from real guests.

language.label: Content language
language.missing: {count, plural, one {# missing translation} other {# missing translations}}
language.fallbackNote: Empty fields fall back to {locale}, the default language of your shop.

previewPage.title: Draft preview
previewPage.note: This preview shows your draft using the same components as the public website. The mobile view narrows the frame; fine layout details can differ on a real phone.
